Hariv. 222

उलूक—चेटी f. a species of owl, VarBṛS.

उलूक—पाक m. the young of an owl g. न्यङ्क्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 53.
उलूक—पुच्छ mf(ई)n. having the shape of the tail of an owl, Pat.
उ॑लूक—यातु (उ॑लूक˚), m. a demon in the shape of an owl, RV. vii, 104, 22; AV. viii, 4, 22.
‘owl's enemy’, a crow, L.
